description: This file contains extension methods for working with TypeConverter and handling generic type representations within the Orleans framework, including parsing and constructing generic types, extracting type arguments, and managing grain type representations.

classes.name: TypeConverterExtensions
classes.description: A static internal class providing extension methods for working with TypeConverter and handling generic type string manipulations.

methods.name: IsGenericType
methods.description: Checks if the given type string indicates a generic type by looking for the '`' character.

methods.name: GetGenericTypeArity
methods.description: Parses the generic arity (number of type parameters) from a type string.

methods.name: IsConstructed
methods.description: Checks if the type string represents a constructed generic type by looking for the '[' character.

methods.name: GetDeconstructed
methods.description: Returns the base generic type name without type arguments.

methods.name: GetConstructed
methods.description: Constructs a generic type string from an unconstructed type and provided type arguments.

methods.name: GetConstructed (for GrainType)
methods.description: Constructs a GrainType instance from a generic grain type and an interface type.

methods.name: GetArguments
methods.description: Retrieves the array of Type objects representing the type arguments of a constructed generic type string.
